svg.title: Shared Workbench UI design proposal
svg.desc: One shared Guide Space with explanation and instance Views, alongside family-owned Spaces.

text.tspan: Space -> View. Guide holds 1 Explanation + 2 Common instance Views. The other Spaces hold 3 Specialized instance work.
Alternative layout · illustrative content and states
One shared Space, with two groups of Views in its sidebar. The groups are navigation labels.

b01_pilot · current Jobs, Tasks and native Run records
Checklist shows the current checks and reading gates.
Goal / Design / Studio / Progress / Checklist share their View structure. Each instance supplies its own goals, work and records.
